record.context_brief: Positive conjugacy classes in types B_n and D_n
record.original_question: Let W be a finite Weyl group with L = ||, let C be a conjugacy class in W, and let C_min be the subset of elements of C having minimal length. For w in C, define N^w in A = Z[v, v^{-1}] to be the trace of the A-linear map H -> H given by h -> v^{2|w|} T_w h T_{w^{-1}}, where H is the Iwahori-Hecke algebra of W. For w in C_min, the paper states that N^w depends only on C, and it calls C positive when N^w belongs to N[v^2]. Determine all positive conjugacy classes when W is a Weyl group of type B_n or D_n.

evidence.quote: We say that C is positive if N w ∈ N[v2].
(d) Make a list of all positive conjugacy classes in W assuming that W is a Weyl group of type Bn or Dn.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $W$ be a finite Weyl group with length function $\ell : W \to \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}$, and let $\mathcal{A} = \mathbb{Z}[v, v^{-1}]$. Let $H$ be the Iwahori–Hecke algebra of $W$ over $\mathcal{A}$, with standard $\mathcal{A}$-basis $\{T_w : w \in W\}$ satisfying the usual relations $(T_s - v^2)(T_s + 1) = 0$ for each simple reflection $s$, and $T_w T_{w'} = T_{ww'}$ when $\ell(ww') = \ell(w) + \ell(w')$.

For each $w \in W$, define
$$N^w \in \mathcal{A}$$
to be the trace of the $\mathcal{A}$-linear endomorphism $H \to H$ given by $h \mapsto v^{2\ell(w)}\, T_w\, h\, T_{w^{-1}}$.

For a conjugacy class $C$ of $W$, let $C_{\min}$ denote the set of elements of $C$ of minimal length. It is known that for $w \in C_{\min}$, the element $N^w$ depends only on $C$; denote this common value by $N^C$. The conjugacy class $C$ is called positive if
$$N^C \in \mathbb{N}[v^2],$$
i.e. $N^C$ is a polynomial in $v^2$ with non-negative integer coefficients.

Problem. Assuming that $W$ is a Weyl group of type $B_n$ or $D_n$, classify all positive conjugacy classes of $W$.
artifact.category_tag: Iwahori–Hecke algebras and Weyl group conjugacy classes
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an explicit open problem by Lusztig in his 2020 list of open problems on Iwahori–Hecke algebras. Earlier work introduced positive conjugacy classes and treated some cases (notably elliptic ones and small/exceptional types), but a complete classification for the classical types B_n and D_n does not appear to have been published. No subsequent paper located in the search provides such a classification, so the problem appears still open.

status_evidence.title: Positive conjugacy classes in Weyl groups (Lusztig)
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces the notion of positive conjugacy class in W, generalizing regular elliptic classes in the sense of Springer.
status_evidence.claim: Defines positive conjugacy classes; classification in B_n, D_n not given.

status_evidence.title: Open problems on Iwahori-Hecke algebras (arXiv:2006.08535)
status_evidence.snippet: The fourth open problem concerns positive conjugacy classes in a Weyl group.
status_evidence.claim: Listing all positive conjugacy classes in types B_n, D_n is stated as an open problem.
